_about: Henry Hayman (1823-1904), headmaster of Rugby: The Odyssey of Homer, edited with marginal references, various readings, notes and appendices (London: David Nutt), vol. I, Books I-VI (1866) and vol. II, Books VII-XII (1873), raw IA OCR; vol. III (1882) was not found on IA. Greek text with English notes, kept per Adam's 2026-10-23 ruling. Not taken: Blaydes's English-commentary Sophocles (1859-1875), whose open scans all OCR the English as Greek letters. Classical scholarship (lane B, round dv). No uids minted.
